domains.name: Companion Pets
domains.promise: Members adopt one companion pet per guild with play-money coins, keep it thriving through feed, play, and train care loops against an always-on stat decay cycle, earn type-specific gameplay perks (hunting, guard, foraging, lucky), battle other members’ pets for play-money rewards, and prestige a max-level pet for permanent stat bonuses — all inside the fake game economy, never touching real commerce.

controls.description: Master switch for companion pets; when off, decay stops and pet commands explain the feature is disabled.
Play-money coin cost of one /pet feed.
Play-money coin cost of one /pet train session.
Hunger points removed from every pet each decay cycle (happiness decays at 80 percent of this rate while energy slowly recovers).
Hours between decay cycles for the guild’s pets.
When hunger or happiness falls to or below this value the pet turns sad; at zero it turns sick and cannot battle.
Whether the pet’s member owner receives a DM nudge when decay turns their pet sad or sick.
Whether /pet battle is available; battles award play-money coins to the winner and pet XP to both sides.
Whether /pet prestige is available; prestiging a level-50 pet resets it to level 1 with permanent stat bonuses.

defaults.rationale: Companion pets are a flagship game-economy loop and ship on for the maximal out-of-box experience.
A light recurring coin sink that keeps care meaningful without punishing casual players.
Training doubles the feed cost so levelling stays a deliberate investment.
Gentle hourly decay: an unattended pet takes days, not hours, to become sad.
Hourly cycles keep stats moving smoothly instead of in big scary jumps.
A 20-point floor gives members a clear warning band before the pet turns sick at zero.
A single caring DM nudge is member-respectful and protects the investment members made in their pet.
Battles are a headline social feature and ship on; owners can switch the piece off independently.
Prestige gives max-level pets a long tail of progression and ships on by default.

domains.name: Daily & Weekly Quests
domains.promise: Every member always carries a personalized slate of daily and weekly quests that auto-refreshes on an always-on cadence — dailies each UTC day, weeklies each UTC Monday — with progress tracked passively from real game-economy activity and rewards claimed as play-money coins and XP via /quests claim; the owner can resize or disable each cadence piece without losing anyone’s progress.

controls.description: Master switch for quests; when off, the cadence stops and quest commands explain the feature is disabled.
How many personalized daily quests each member receives per UTC day; zero disables the daily piece while weeklies continue.
How many personalized weekly quests each member receives per ISO week; zero disables the weekly piece while dailies continue.
Base play-money coin reward that quest templates scale from.

defaults.rationale: An always-on quest loop gives every member a reason to return daily; core to the maximal experience.
Three dailies fit a single play session without feeling like a chore list.
Five weeklies give steady mid-term goals across a whole week of varied activity.
A meaningful play-coin baseline that quest templates scale by difficulty; fully owner-tunable.

domains.promise: Milestone badges unlock passively and exactly once from real activity — including hidden achievements that stay masked in /badges until earned — and members who reach the owner-set level and play-money net-worth thresholds can /prestige: wallet and bank reset in exchange for a permanent earning multiplier that grows by a fixed step per prestige and is bounded by an owner-set cap. Every reward and reset lives entirely in the fake game economy.

defaults.rationale: Passive badges celebrate genuine activity out of the box with zero owner setup.
Prestige gives long-term players an endgame loop and ships on; owners can switch the piece off independently.
Level 50 marks a genuinely invested member; prestige should feel earned.
A million play coins makes the reset a real sacrifice that the permanent multiplier meaningfully repays.
A 10 percent step per prestige compounds into real progression without instantly distorting the game economy.
Capping at prestige 10 (a +100 percent ceiling) keeps multipliers bounded so the play-money economy stays balanced forever.

defaults.rationale: Trivia is instant social fun and ships on for the maximal out-of-box experience.
